28. The samayas — the rules of the initiated
Right.
blocks.directed:
28. The samayas — the rules of the initiated
Right.

blocks.text: The mantra has been entrusted to you.
blocks.directed: The mantra has been entrusted to you.

blocks.text: The guru has performed the required consecrations.
blocks.directed: The guru has performed the required consecrations.

blocks.text: Now you need to understand what conduct is expected of you.
blocks.directed: Now you need to understand what conduct is expected of you.

blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta gives an extensive collection of observances.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta gives an extensive collection of observances.

blocks.text: The same devotion extends to scripture and deity.
blocks.directed: The same devotion extends to scripture and deity.

blocks.text: And the disciple is instructed to turn away from what opposes them.
blocks.directed: And the disciple is instructed to turn away from what opposes them.

blocks.text: Now, we’ve already discussed Abhinavagupta’s unusually high conception of the guru in Chapter Eleven.
blocks.directed: Now, we’ve already discussed Abhinavagupta’s unusually high conception of the guru in Chapter Eleven.

blocks.text: So it’s no surprise that this appears first.
blocks.directed: So it’s no surprise that this appears first.

blocks.text: But here it becomes a formal religious commitment.
blocks.directed: But here it becomes a formal religious commitment.

blocks.text: Those joined to the guru through the transmission of knowledge.
blocks.directed: Those joined to the guru through the transmission of knowledge.

blocks.text: Previously initiated members of the tradition.
blocks.directed: Previously initiated members of the tradition.

blocks.text: These are to be treated with appropriate respect.
blocks.directed: These are to be treated with appropriate respect.

blocks.text: And the text also refers to relationships of sexual or familial association, emphasising their relation to ritual service rather than merely personal gratification.
blocks.directed: And the text also refers to relationships of sexual or familial association, emphasising their relation to ritual service rather than merely personal gratification.

blocks.text: This is part of a historically specific tantric social structure.
blocks.directed: This is part of a historically specific tantric social structure.

blocks.text: It shouldn’t be read as giving a teacher or community unrestricted authority over another person’s intimate relationships.
blocks.directed: It shouldn’t be read as giving a teacher or community unrestricted authority over another person’s intimate relationships.

blocks.text: Do not treat women with contempt on the specified grounds.
blocks.directed: Do not treat women with contempt on the specified grounds.

blocks.text: The Sanskrit includes a prescription concerning women and aversion, including reference to barrenness.
blocks.directed: The Sanskrit includes a prescription concerning women and aversion, including reference to barrenness.

blocks.text: The point is that a disciple should not make a woman’s condition a cause for disgust or rejection.
blocks.directed: The point is that a disciple should not make a woman’s condition a cause for disgust or rejection.

blocks.text: Now, that’s worth noticing amid the more hierarchical rules that follow.
blocks.directed: Now, that’s worth noticing amid the more hierarchical rules that follow.

blocks.text: Don’t casually pronounce the deity’s name, the guru’s name or the mantra outside the proper context of worship.
blocks.directed: Don’t casually pronounce the deity’s name, the guru’s name or the mantra outside the proper context of worship.

blocks.text: The sacred names are governed by rules of ritual usage.
blocks.directed: The sacred names are governed by rules of ritual usage.

blocks.text: Not simply to be shouted about whenever you feel like it.
blocks.directed: Not simply to be shouted about whenever you feel like it.

blocks.text: Don’t use the guru’s personal possessions, such as their bed.
blocks.directed: Don’t use the guru’s personal possessions, such as their bed.

blocks.text: Again, the formal separation between teacher and disciple is being maintained.
blocks.directed: Again, the formal separation between teacher and disciple is being maintained.

blocks.text: Don’t engage in casual worldly play or amusement in the guru’s presence.
blocks.directed: Don’t engage in casual worldly play or amusement in the guru’s presence.

blocks.text: This is about maintaining the appropriate religious decorum.
blocks.directed: This is about maintaining the appropriate religious decorum.

blocks.text: Don’t regard anyone else as superior to the guru.
blocks.directed: Don’t regard anyone else as superior to the guru.

blocks.text: Now, this is an explicitly hierarchical rule.
blocks.directed: Now, this is an explicitly hierarchical rule.

blocks.text: And it follows from the conception of the guru as the embodiment of the highest liberating knowledge.
blocks.directed: And it follows from the conception of the guru as the embodiment of the highest liberating knowledge.

blocks.text: It is not a reliable practical safeguard against a teacher’s misconduct; that requires independent judgment and accountability.
blocks.directed: It is not a reliable practical safeguard against a teacher’s misconduct; that requires independent judgment and accountability.

blocks.text: Honour the guru in rites such as ancestral offerings.
blocks.directed: Honour the guru in rites such as ancestral offerings.

blocks.text: Avoid certain esoteric terms, including Śākinī, in specified occasional rites.
blocks.directed: Avoid certain esoteric terms, including Śākinī, in specified occasional rites.

blocks.text: The ritual vocabulary itself is regulated.
blocks.directed: The ritual vocabulary itself is regulated.

blocks.text: Now, here’s where the sectarian character of the historical text becomes extremely explicit.
blocks.directed: Now, here’s where the sectarian character of the historical text becomes extremely explicit.

blocks.text: Abhinavagupta instructs disciples not to associate religiously with Vaiṣṇavas and others whom his tradition classifies as holding inferior views.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta instructs disciples not to associate religiously with Vaiṣṇavas and others whom his tradition classifies as holding inferior views.

blocks.text: And even if someone previously accepted such a person as a guru through curiosity about another scripture, the disciple is instructed to leave that relationship without treating themselves as superior.
blocks.directed: And even if someone previously accepted such a person as a guru through curiosity about another scripture, the disciple is instructed to leave that relationship without treating themselves as superior.

blocks.text: Now, that’s a doctrinal boundary of this particular religious system.
blocks.directed: Now, that’s a doctrinal boundary of this particular religious system.

blocks.text: It shouldn’t be confused with a universal requirement to avoid people of other faiths.
blocks.directed: It shouldn’t be confused with a universal requirement to avoid people of other faiths.

blocks.text: But it is present in the Sanskrit, and we’re not going to pretend Abhinavagupta was writing modern interfaith pluralism.
blocks.directed: But it is present in the Sanskrit, and we’re not going to pretend Abhinavagupta was writing modern interfaith pluralism.

blocks.text: Do not judge members of the tradition by their previous birth-status or caste.
blocks.directed: Do not judge members of the tradition by their previous birth-status or caste.

blocks.text: And within the sacred circle, do not construct distinctions between superior and inferior participants on the basis of birth.
blocks.directed: And within the sacred circle, do not construct distinctions between superior and inferior participants on the basis of birth.

blocks.text: The text strongly asserts a hierarchy of religious doctrines and guru qualifications, yet also rejects the relevance of birth-based hierarchy within the consecrated tantric circle.
blocks.directed: The text strongly asserts a hierarchy of religious doctrines and guru qualifications, yet also rejects the relevance of birth-based hierarchy within the consecrated tantric circle.

blocks.text: So the same chapter contains both strong sectarian boundaries and a repudiation of certain conventional social distinctions inside the initiated community.
blocks.directed: So the same chapter contains both strong sectarian boundaries and a repudiation of certain conventional social distinctions inside the initiated community.

blocks.text: That tension is part of the tradition’s actual historical structure.
blocks.directed: That tension is part of the tradition’s actual historical structure.

blocks.text: Now, the guru’s community is to be honoured when its members come to the disciple’s home.
blocks.directed: Now, the guru’s community is to be honoured when its members come to the disciple’s home.

blocks.text: Other religious ascetics may be treated respectfully without mixing ritual observances.
blocks.directed: Other religious ascetics may be treated respectfully without mixing ritual observances.

blocks.text: And the disciple is instructed to abandon doubts that obstruct the religious commitment.
blocks.directed: And the disciple is instructed to abandon doubts that obstruct the religious commitment.

blocks.text: But here’s a particularly beautiful instruction.
blocks.directed: But here’s a particularly beautiful instruction.

blocks.text: Don’t regard any external shrine or pilgrimage place as superior to the body itself.
blocks.directed: Don’t regard any external shrine or pilgrimage place as superior to the body itself.

blocks.text: Śarīrāt ṛte na anyat āyatana-tīrthādikaṃ bahumānena paśyet.
blocks.directed: Śarīrāt ṛte na anyat āyatana-tīrthādikaṃ bahumānena paśyet.

blocks.text: But now the initiated disciple is told that the body itself possesses profound sacred significance.
blocks.directed: But now the initiated disciple is told that the body itself possesses profound sacred significance.

blocks.text: Because the body is not merely something separate from the divine.
blocks.directed: Because the body is not merely something separate from the divine.

blocks.text: It’s a support in which the divine powers can be installed and recognised.
blocks.directed: It’s a support in which the divine powers can be installed and recognised.

blocks.text: And through the appropriate understanding, it becomes a sacred field.
blocks.directed: And through the appropriate understanding, it becomes a sacred field.

blocks.text: Now, the final observance is particularly important.
blocks.directed: Now, the final observance is particularly important.

blocks.text: Remember the Heart of the mantra continuously.
blocks.directed: Remember the Heart of the mantra continuously.

blocks.text: Not simply the number of repetitions.
blocks.directed: Not simply the number of repetitions.

blocks.text: The living conscious reality expressed by the mantra.
blocks.directed: The living conscious reality expressed by the mantra.

blocks.text: And the disciple is instructed to maintain that remembrance.
blocks.directed: And the disciple is instructed to maintain that remembrance.

blocks.text: Now, do you see the shape of the whole initiation?
blocks.directed: Now, do you see the shape of the whole initiation?

blocks.text: The external ceremony prepares the disciple.
blocks.directed: The external ceremony prepares the disciple.

blocks.text: The religious commitments establish a continuing discipline.
blocks.directed: The religious commitments establish a continuing discipline.

blocks.text: And the disciple is directed toward constant remembrance of the inner essence of the mantra.
blocks.directed: And the disciple is directed toward constant remembrance of the inner essence of the mantra.

blocks.text: Not merely receiving a certificate saying:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Not merely receiving a certificate saying:

blocks.text: But assuming a new ritual and contemplative relationship with the powers of Śiva.
blocks.directed: But assuming a new ritual and contemplative relationship with the powers of Śiva.

blocks.text: And now the chapter comes to its final acts.
blocks.directed: And now the chapter comes to its final acts.

29. The disciple honours the guru and the community
Having heard the observances, the disciple bows.
blocks.directed:
29. The disciple honours the guru and the community
Having heard the observances, the disciple bows.

blocks.text: Then the guru is honoured with:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Then the guru is honoured with:

blocks.text: The traditional gift or fee offered to the teacher.
blocks.directed: The traditional gift or fee offered to the teacher.

blocks.text: And the wording here is unusually sweeping.
blocks.directed: And the wording here is unusually sweeping.

blocks.text: It refers to offerings extending even to wealth, wife and body.
blocks.directed: It refers to offerings extending even to wealth, wife and body.

blocks.text: Now, that is a historically important but ethically troubling formulation.
blocks.directed: Now, that is a historically important but ethically troubling formulation.

blocks.text: It belongs to a ritual culture in which offering everything to the guru could be used to signify total surrender.
blocks.directed: It belongs to a ritual culture in which offering everything to the guru could be used to signify total surrender.

blocks.text: It is not a legitimate modern basis for transferring control of one’s spouse, body or personal autonomy to a religious teacher.
blocks.directed: It is not a legitimate modern basis for transferring control of one’s spouse, body or personal autonomy to a religious teacher.

blocks.text: But faithfully describing the passage requires acknowledging the actual breadth of the prescription.
blocks.directed: But faithfully describing the passage requires acknowledging the actual breadth of the prescription.

blocks.text: Then the disciple makes offerings to previously initiated members of the tradition.
blocks.directed: Then the disciple makes offerings to previously initiated members of the tradition.

blocks.text: The initiation doesn’t conclude exclusively with the guru.
blocks.directed: The initiation doesn’t conclude exclusively with the guru.

blocks.text: The disciple is also instructed to provide for vulnerable people.
blocks.directed: The disciple is also instructed to provide for vulnerable people.

blocks.text: And then the divine circle of forms is satisfied through the prescribed procedure.
blocks.directed: And then the divine circle of forms is satisfied through the prescribed procedure.

blocks.text: Now, after all that, Abhinavagupta gives the actual result.
blocks.directed: Now, after all that, Abhinavagupta gives the actual result.

blocks.text:
30. Congratulations. You’re now a samayī.
Itthaṃ samayī bhavati.
blocks.directed:
30. Congratulations. You’re now a samayī.
Itthaṃ samayī bhavati.

blocks.text: And what does that entitle the disciple to do?
blocks.directed: And what does that entitle the disciple to do?

blocks.text: Now, this is an important limitation.
blocks.directed: Now, this is an important limitation.

blocks.text: The initiation qualifies the disciple for these activities.
blocks.directed: The initiation qualifies the disciple for these activities.

blocks.text: It doesn’t automatically qualify them to perform every advanced ritual independently.
blocks.directed: It doesn’t automatically qualify them to perform every advanced ritual independently.

blocks.text: For occasional or special rites, naimittika, the disciple must seek the guru’s assistance or authorisation.
blocks.directed: For occasional or special rites, naimittika, the disciple must seek the guru’s assistance or authorisation.

blocks.text: So there are levels of qualification.
blocks.directed: So there are levels of qualification.

blocks.text: Well, here’s the first formal stage.
blocks.directed: Well, here’s the first formal stage.

blocks.text: And Abhinavagupta ends the chapter with a wonderfully concise sentence.
blocks.directed: And Abhinavagupta ends the chapter with a wonderfully concise sentence.

blocks.text:
इति सामयिको विधिः
Iti sāmayiko vidhiḥ.
blocks.directed:
[slowly] इति सामयिको विधिः
Iti sāmayiko vidhiḥ.

blocks.text: Thus concludes the procedure pertaining to the samayī.
blocks.directed: Thus concludes the procedure pertaining to the samayī.

blocks.text: And now, consider what Abhinavagupta has accomplished.
blocks.directed: And now, consider what Abhinavagupta has accomplished.

blocks.text: He began with the condition of the Heart.
blocks.directed: He began with the condition of the Heart.

blocks.text: The place where divine immersion becomes possible.
blocks.directed: The place where divine immersion becomes possible.

blocks.text: Then he installed Śakti in the body.
blocks.directed: Then he installed Śakti in the body.

blocks.text: He explained why the entire action of worship must be recognised as non-different from Śiva.
blocks.directed: He explained why the entire action of worship must be recognised as non-different from Śiva.

blocks.text: He transformed the directions into expressions of consciousness.
blocks.directed: He transformed the directions into expressions of consciousness.

blocks.text: Then the body into a divine support.
blocks.directed: Then the body into a divine support.

blocks.text: Then the entire cosmic hierarchy into a trident and lotus.
blocks.directed: Then the entire cosmic hierarchy into a trident and lotus.

blocks.text: Then defined worship as offering the whole universe into the fullness of awareness.
blocks.directed: Then defined worship as offering the whole universe into the fullness of awareness.

blocks.text: And after all that, he constructed the external ceremony.
blocks.directed: And after all that, he constructed the external ceremony.

blocks.text: And finally the observances by which the disciple enters the discipline of Trika.
blocks.directed: And finally the observances by which the disciple enters the discipline of Trika.

blocks.text: Now, here’s the most important thing.
blocks.directed: Now, here’s the most important thing.

blocks.text: The outward ritual isn’t simply an elaborate performance designed to entertain the gods.
blocks.directed: The outward ritual isn’t simply an elaborate performance designed to entertain the gods.

blocks.text: It’s an organised transformation of the entire field of experience.
blocks.directed: It’s an organised transformation of the entire field of experience.

blocks.text: The materials used in the action.
blocks.directed: The materials used in the action.

blocks.text: The very space in which the action occurs.
blocks.directed: The very space in which the action occurs.

blocks.text: All are consecrated as manifestations of Parameśvara.
blocks.directed: All are consecrated as manifestations of Parameśvara.

blocks.text: And through that process, the ritual becomes a method of recognition.
blocks.directed: And through that process, the ritual becomes a method of recognition.

blocks.text: Now think about how remarkable that is.
blocks.directed: Now think about how remarkable that is.

blocks.text: You began as a little individual who believed:
blocks.directed: [short pause] You began as a little individual who believed:
[short pause] “I’m going to offer him something.”

blocks.text: But by the end of the ritual, every one of those apparently separate things has been recognised within one conscious reality.
blocks.directed: But by the end of the ritual, every one of those apparently separate things has been recognised within one conscious reality.

blocks.text: And the disciple is no longer simply an outsider admiring the tradition.
blocks.directed: And the disciple is no longer simply an outsider admiring the tradition.

blocks.text: They’ve been brought into its consecrated field and entrusted with the discipline that sustains its practice.
blocks.directed: They’ve been brought into its consecrated field and entrusted with the discipline that sustains its practice.

blocks.text: You’ve spent eleven chapters studying metaphysics.
blocks.directed: You’ve spent eleven chapters studying metaphysics.

blocks.text: And now an entire chapter learning how to conduct divine worship and initiate somebody into the tradition.
blocks.directed: And now an entire chapter learning how to conduct divine worship and initiate somebody into the tradition.

blocks.text: And somehow, after all those mantras, flowers, vessels, fires, goddesses, directions, subtle centres and sacred obligations, you’ve arrived at precisely the same recognition with which we started.
blocks.directed: And somehow, after all those mantras, flowers, vessels, fires, goddesses, directions, subtle centres and sacred obligations, you’ve arrived at precisely the same recognition with which we started.

blocks.text: There is nothing outside the freedom of consciousness.
blocks.directed: There is nothing outside the freedom of consciousness.

blocks.text: The whole bloody ritual is Śiva recognising Śiva.
blocks.directed: The whole bloody ritual is Śiva recognising Śiva.

blocks.text: And that is the heart of pūjā.
blocks.directed: And that is the heart of pūjā.
